questions.question: Can the chart’s visible tick labels be checked and recorded to confirm the encoding assumed by r1: y-axis labels rise from 0 at the bottom through 2, 4, 6, and 8 upward, and x-axis year ticks progress left-to-right through 2018?

summary: Inspected the plotted single series, the visibly higher 2018 endpoint, its attachment to the 2018 tick, the title/axis wording, and the task’s year-specific and methodology options. The existing chains cover both the conditional 2018 peak reading and the rate-versus-count labeling limitation; the remaining support gap is explicit visual confirmation of the axis-direction encoding used by the peak rule.
